Die Schweizer Bergbahnen führen durch majestätische Landschafte. Diese Folge führt mit der Zahnradbahn auf den Monte Generoso. Vom Gipfel auf 1601 Metern hat man einen spektakulären Rundumblick auf die höchsten Berge der Schweizer Alpen.

Die Schynige-Platte-Bahn im Berner Oberland ist Ziel einer ganz besonderen Fahrt mit der Zahnradbahn. Seit über 130 Jahren tuckern die Dampfzüge von Wilderswil gemächlich den Berg hoch. Die Fahrt ist eine Reise zurück in der Zeit.

Mit der Bahn durchs Winterwunderland Schweiz: Es geht in die entlegensten Täler, auf die höchsten Berge, durch beeindruckende Landschaften. Dank unzähliger Tunnel und Viadukte ist die Region im Herzen der Alpen ein Paradies für Bahnreisende.

Im Südwesten Kambodschas findet sich mit dem Kardamom Gebirge eine wahre Schatzkammer grüner Biodiversität. Um diesen einzigartigen Lebensraum zu erhalten, setzen sich zahlreiche Menschen für seinen Schutz ein und erforschen teils unbekannte Arten.

Mit der Ruhe ist es Anfang 1990 schlagartig vorbei, als Holmer dem gestürzten Staatsratsvorsitzenden Erich Honecker und seiner Frau Margot, der langjährigen Ministerin für Volksbildung, Unterkunft im Pfarrhaus gewährt. Sie sehen es als ihre christliche Pflicht an, den nunmehr Obdachlosen eine Unterkunft zu gewähren.

Als der Gauner Dutch Albert in einer Western-Stadt auftaucht, ist das friedliche Zusammenleben schnell vorbei. Der Bestatter Patrick Tate kann damit eigentlich leben, denn sein Geschäft läuft richtig gut, dank der zahlreichen Leichen, die sich im Ort anhäufen. Doch seine Familie leidet unter der Gesetzlosigkeit und ihr Leben steht auf dem Spiel. Patrick muss schlussendlich eine Entscheidung treffen, die über Leben und Tod bestimmt.

Brad und Janet sind frisch verlobt und auf dem Weg zu ihrem gemeinsamen Freund Dr. Everett Scott. Unterwegs erleiden sie jedoch eine Autopanne. In der Nähe finden sie ein altes Schloss, in dem sie Unterschlupf suchen. Der bucklige Diener Riff Raff und das Hausmädchen Magenta lassen sie herein und führen sie zu ihrem noch unheimlicheren Herrn. Dr. Frank N. Furter experimentiert gerade damit, einen Menschen künstlich herzustellen. Brad und Janet erleben eine alles verändernde Horrorshow.

pr.t: Die Rocky Horror Show: Eine wilde Geschichte
pr.d: Anhand seltener Archivaufnahmen wird die Erfolgsgeschichte der "Rocky Horror Show" nacherzählt. Alles begann mit einer kleinen Londoner Theaterproduktion, aus der spätestens mit dem Kinofilm ein weltweites Popkultur-Phänomen wurde.

1963 wird ein Familienvater zum Mörder. Er bringt erst eine Ehefrau um, anschließend seine Kinder, seine Eltern und den Familienhund. Er möchte danach seine Geliebte umbringen. Ein Schriftsteller rätselt an dem Fall und stellt sich viele Fragen.
In dem Magazin präsentiert die Journalistin Sonia Devillers die Interpretation von Bildern.

Ein Tierfilmer begleitet fünf Bärenarten aus aller Welt ein Jahr lang mit der Kamera. In Rumänien sind es die Braunbären, in Kamtschatka die Grizzlybären, in der Arktis die Eisbären und in British Columbia die Schwarzbären und der Kermodebär.

Lange Zeit war Frauenboxen auf Kuba verboten, obwohl der Faustkampf traditionell zu den erfolgreichsten Sportarten auf der Karibikinsel gehört. Damit ist seit kurzem Schluss und die nächste Generation steht bereits in den Startlöchern.

Auf dem Rialtomarkt werden Delikatessen verkauft, die zur kulinarischen Tradition von Venedig gehören. Mit dem Boot frisch von den Inseln Sant'Erasmo und Le Vignole werden Artischocken, Riesentomaten und Jujube-Früchte geliefert.

Die Markthallen von Dijon sind ein riesiges Areal mit über 700 Ständen, die sich auf vier Pavillons verteilen. Die äußeren Stände bieten eine vielfältige Auswahl an Fleisch, Geflügel und Wurstwaren. Bio-Gemüse und ein Käsesortiment sind im Zentrum.

Der fast einen Kilometer lange Hamburger Isemarkt ist einer der bedeutendsten Märkte, die die Stadt zu bieten hat. Unter dem Hochbahnviadukt zwischen zwei U-Bahn-Stationen sammeln sich 200 Stände mit Obst, Brot, Gemüse, Fisch, Backwaren und Bonbons.

Frühmorgens führt die junge Lara ihren Hund Max Gassi. Nach der Schule geht sie einkaufen, abends kocht sie. Die gemeinsame Wohnung putzt sie mit ihrem Bruder Luka, der auch die Miete zahlt. So sieht der Alltag der Geschwister in Skopje aus. Die beiden sind in der nordmazedonischen Hauptstadt auf sich allein gestellt, während ihre Eltern im Ausland leben und arbeiten.

Obwohl es bereits seit Jahrtausenden zu den Grundnahrungsmitteln zählt, ist das Brot heute als Kulturgut gefragter denn je. Verschiedene Bäcker zeigen, wie sie die traditionelle Handwerkskunst des Backens mit kreativen Ideen verknüpfen.

Mia hat einen Terroranschlag in einem Bistro überlebt. Sie ist noch drei Monate später traumatisiert und kann sich nicht an die Ereignisse jener Nacht erinnern. Daraufhin versucht sie, ihre Erinnerungen zu ergründen und ihr Leben wiederzugewinnen.

Das Rheinland liegt zu beiden Seiten des Rheins im Nordwesten Deutschlands. Anfang November gedenkt man hier mit bunten Laternenumzügen dem heiligen Martin. Die Kinder bekommen Weckmänner aus süßem Hefeteig und als Festessen werden Martinsgänse.

Vielfalt und Reichtum Sloweniens sind auf dem Zentralmarkt von Ljubljana perfekt vertreten. Zwei offene Plätze beherbergen die Stände mit frischem Obst und Gemüse, während auf der langen Uferpromenade der Fischmarkt zu finden ist.

Serbien besitzt zwar keinen Zugang zum Meer, wird jedoch stark vom Wasser geprägt. Die großen Flüsse wie die Donau nähren artenreiche Ökosysteme, während das Eiserne Tor als atemberaubendes UNESCO-Weltnaturerbe fasziniert.

Am nördlichsten Punkt des Golfs mündet der berühmte Colorado River in das Aquarium der Welt. Das Mündungsdelta gilt als die Wiege des Golfes und grenzt an die Sonora-Wüste, eine der größten und artenreichsten Wüstenregionen der Welt.

pr.t: Die kleinen und die großen Lügen
pr.d: Nach einem schweren Autounfall lag Unternehmer Felix viele Wochen im Krankenhaus. Seine Entlassung feiert seine Frau Anne mit einer Überraschungsparty, zu der sie nur engste Freunde einlädt. Unverhofft taucht auch die vom Regen durchnässte Micha auf, die in der Runde niemand kennt. Die verzweifelte Frau aus einem sozial schwachen Stadtviertel sucht ihre vermisste Tochter bereits seit dem Abend, an dem Felix seinen Unfall hatte.

Der Filmemacher Jonathan Demme fängt die unbändige Energie und den künstlerischen Groove der Talking Heads ein, als sie im Jahr 1983 im Hollywood Pantages Theatre Hits wie "Psycho Killer" und "Take Me to the River" aufführen. Der Konzertfilm ist ein wesentliches Zeugnis der unvergleichlichen Energie, die die Band auf der Bühne versprühen konnte. Die Talking Heads bieten eine Performance, die ebenso zerebral wie intensiv und verspielt ist.

Die zehnjährige Aurore lebt mit ihrer Mutter in der südfranzösischen Camargue. Oft unternimmt sie heimliche Ausflüge in die Sümpfe, um dort zu tanzen oder im Schilf herumzustreunen. Als sie eines Nachmittags wieder einmal ihrer Mutter entwischt, trifft sie sich mit ihrem besten Freund Chris auf dem Spielplatz ihres Viertels. Dort spielen der vierjährige Paulo und seine zweijährige Schwester Maya unbeaufsichtigt im Sandkasten.

pr.t: AI: Probably Nothing to Worry About [NEW]
pr.d: The fullest account yet of AI's origins, told by the people who built it. Not just a tech history lesson but an anarchic thriller, this is the story of a technology whose power isn't in the algorithms, but in the handful of people who control it.

After Pierre's sudden collapse, he's discharged from hospital under strict instructions to avoid stress. But when he receives an anonymous tip-off, he can't resist the chance to discover what really happened to Michael.
Ronnie has some explaining to do, but is it too late? In a bid to strike fear into Pierre, Jimmy Vale ups his campaign. And Miriam faces criminal charges in court, with only Danny in her corner.

Stephanie Patrick veers down a path of self-destruction after a tragic plane crash kills her family. When Stephanie discovers it wasn't an accident, she soon embarks on a bloody quest for revenge to punish those responsible.

Unreported World reports from Johannesburg, where speaking out against corruption can be a death sentence. Reporter Darshna Soni investigates the business of contract killers who are used to silence whistleblowers.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

pr.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
pr.d: Kirstie and Phil are off to Mapperley in Nottinghamshire where Sue and husband Richard agree that their beautiful home is no longer fit for purpose, but they can't agree on whether to stay put or move on.

Norm has debts at Cheers. To pay it off, he repaints Rebecca's office, and in the process, he gets to know her better. He realises that behind her rough exterior lies a soft core, a development which does not go unnoticed by Sam.

Cliff's mother approves the demolition of their old home for $250,000 from a real estate agent. Cliff handcuffs himself to a pole as a protest. Meanwhile, the Cheers regulars learn that, when she was a college student, Rebecca was a party girl.
After Carrie's constant togetherness with Doug he finds a friend for her. Soon Doug regrets his actions after Carrie and her new friend are always together leaving Doug alone.
Doug staples himself with a staple gun in a 'private' place while fooling around at work. Rather than go to the hospital, he struggles through a loan interview with Carrie.
Deacon and Kelly ask Doug and Carrie if they want to be their children's Godparents. Overcome with the compliment, Doug instantly says yes, but Carrie is not completely on board.
Ray is jealous when an inexperienced colleague beats him to his lifelong ambition of having an article published in 'Sports Illustrated'.
Nobody likes Raymond after his negative comments about marriage lead to the break-up of Robert and Amy.
Ray and his family are crushed when Marie cooks up a tofu turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
Frasier's and Niles' new romantic interests create a wedge between the brothers when each thinks the other is moving in on his woman.
The Russian origin of Martin's clock prompts Frasier and Niles to look for evidence they're descendants of the Romanov dynasty.

Reports of Frasier's death are greatly exaggerated. Nonetheless, he's disappointed to realise that he hasn't achieved what he'd set out to in life. Meanwhile, Niles decides to settle a score with a plastic surgeon and is shocked to find out he is attracted to her.
A scheming Frederick (Trevor Einhorn) tries to get Frasier and Lilith (Bebe Neuwirth) back together during Thanksgiving dinner.
The guys are invited to pick a Vermont property packed with "petroliana;" Mike tackles two projects in Iowa; Frank and Dave try to buy an ultra-rare cycle car in Florida.
Channel 4's midday news summary.
Tracey and Rob face a last-minute problem at their Scottish castle, which could put the dampeners on their wedding day. And in Cumbria, Ben and Paul give the servant's quarters living room a glow up.

Sidhbh and Neasa launch their new Miami clinic with a party in an operating theatre. Tony and Keegan shoot some content for their YouTube channel at Florida's original theme park. And Orlando wrestler D-Wayne contends with a bad knee.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Mike Bubbins in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

Laura Hamilton is house-hunting around the Dordogne's medieval town of Sarlat in France with Nikki and her mum Rosaline from Aberdeenshire. With a budget of £250,000, Laura shows them five fantastic options.

In France, Karen and Steve are forced to rethink plans for their 17th-century settlement. In Italy, after a 17-year battle, will Andrew and Katja finally be able to move into their medieval palazzo? Work at Mike's mountainside village grinds to halt.
It is a feisty old payment day after a week packed to the gills with gripes. The tension can be cut with a knife. Fortunately, they are not given any knives.

On the final night in Bolton, exuberant financial advisor Louis is hoping that his fancy fine-dining menu will shock his guests into giving him perfect tens. His posh nosh includes lamb Wellington and a dessert that bucks the week's cheesecake trend.

Pauline and her son Robert are looking for a holiday home on the northern Costa Blanca. For their budget of £275k, Lee Juggurnauth shows them five great properties, from a noisy non-starter to a budget buster that makes a splash.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

Reporter Guillermo Galdos is in Mexico's border city of Juárez, where it's claimed that children as young as 11 are being recruited by drug cartels, and families turn to unregulated rehab clinics to save their kids - with mixed results.

Sophie has uprooted her life to fulfil her dream of moving back to the Sheffield suburb of Hillsborough, where she spent her childhood, and into her grandparents' old house. But the house she's come back to is not the stuff of dreams.
Britain's sharpest armchair critics share more of their sharp, insightful, passionate and sometimes emotional critiques of the week's biggest and best shows on television.
Offering their unmatched satirical insight into current world events, Adam, Josh and Alex are joined by Harriet Dyer and Josh Pugh to help dissect the biggest news stories of the week.

Jon Richardson returns to the stand-up circuit to complain about the world and offer no solutions, on topics including parenthood, Brexit, haircuts, and the question of why nobody but him can correctly load a dishwasher.
...Worry About: The definitive story of AI's origins, told by the people who built it. Exclusive interviews put AI pioneers and ex OpenAI staff on the record on the perils of the new tech.

Series finale of the legal drama starring David Harewood. Pierre will stop at nothing to uncover the truth as the case reaches a dramatic conclusion. (Ep6/6)

South Africa's Whistleblower Hitmen: In Johannesburg, calling out corruption can be a death sentence. Darshna Soni investigates the contract killers silencing corporate whistleblowers.
Some extra brunch as Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer host the food and chat show.

The gang are having fun in Las Vegas, where Monica and Chandler get lucky, Rachel makes Ross regret playing a prank on her, and Joey schemes for fame and fortune.

Everyone is toasting Chandler and Monica's engagement, but after Chandler fails to come up with the goods in the bedroom, he begins to worry about the consequences. Elsewhere, Monica thinks Rachel is trying to steal her glory when she catches her kissing Ross.

Monica's dream of a fairytale wedding fizzles out after she learns what her parents have done with her wedding fund. Meanwhile, Rachel fumes when a teasing Joey stumbles across her juicy late-night reading material.

Chandler's desperate effort to bond with Monica's dad by playing racquetball backfires when he accidentally gets too up-close-and-personal. Elsewhere, Rachel tries to teach 'landlubber' Joey how to sail without falling overboard, while Monica seeks to replicate Phoebe's late grandmother's secret recipe by deconstructing her last remaining cookie.

Rachel must hire an assistant and agonises over whether to hire an efficient, experienced woman, or sexy young Tag Jones. Ignoring her friends' advice, she hires Tag and soon regrets it. To make matters worse, Tag is attracted to Phoebe.

While taking an engagement picture for himself and Monica, Chandler can't stop pulling a strange face, Rachel enlists Joey to take Tag out for a night on the town, and Phoebe and Ross date a couple in the middle of a divorce.

Wedding fever continues when Monica can't decide whether to appoint Rachel or Phoebe as her maid of honour. To help Monica decide, Joey and Ross test them on how they would react in certain wedding situations.

Ross is elated that the university library contains his doctoral dissertation, but he is shocked to discover that it is located in a remote corner frequently used by students having sex. Elsewhere, the tables are turned on Joey when Erin is the one to just want sex and not a relationship.

Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during Thanksgiving dinner, and Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a cute dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.

Rachel is dating her assistant, Tag, but they must keep it a secret at work because of the company's anti-dating policy. Her friends warn her that the relationship will only cause her trouble, but just for fun, she becomes more brazen about it.
Ross finds himself looking after Ben and decides to do something special. Since all the Santa costumes have been rented out, Ross dons the holiday armadillo outfit.

Chandler and Rachel pig out on a neighbour's cheesecake that was mistakenly delivered to Chandler. They feel bad, but not quite guilty enough to refrain from eating a second one that has also been wrongly delivered.
During their first night together, Rachel and Tag realise they forgot to ship out an important package at the office.

Phoebe's new job as a telemarketer gets off to a tricky start when the first person she calls, an office worker called Earl, tells her he feels unappreciated and wants to kill himself. Phoebe keeps him on the telephone, trying to persuade him otherwise and finally takes the desperate measure of going to his office to convince him to stay alive.

Celebrating Rachel's 30th birthday inspires the friends to reminisce about their own 30th birthdays. Joey got angry with God for breaking their deal, Ross bought himself a sports car in an attempt to recapture his youth, and Monica got blind drunk and embarrassed herself at her surprise party.

David Dickinson and David Ford, Henry Nicholls and Helen Gardiner help the people of Winsford sort their treasures from their rubbish. They try their best to buy their favourite items, but it is an antique amputation kit that causes a stir today.

Seth's security crackdown rubs the redeem girls the wrong way, and American Jewellery comes up short-staffed, forcing the Golds to man the windows. Out of his element, Seth struggles to stay on the ball.

Seth and Ashley battle it out to see who can bring in more new customers to the store. Ashley's idea really blows up, but Seth has a secret plan in the works, and one that might just push his sister over the edge, and out of American Jewelry.

Customer drama is nothing new to the Golds, but when uproar in the pawn line reveals that an employee may be taking bribes, Ashley vows to get to the bottom of things, Les and Seth brush off her conspiracy theory.

With employee relations not his strong suit, Seth tries to make amends by moving staff around, but his plan backfires when his swap leads to a staff throw down and Les checks out an old school peep show.

With their father-son relationship already on the rocks, a major miscommunication between Les and Seth could land a key employee on the chopping block. Ashley tries to keep the peace, but the damage may be too deep.
When Les allows a $60,000 watch to walk out the door on a handshake agreement, Seth and Ashley flip out. A life-sized Silver Surfer slides into the shop, and Didgeridoo leaves the staff breathless.

In the wake of Les' bum watch deal, Seth and Ashley get on his case to curb his crazy buys. He makes a deal to get the kids off his back, but when some interesting animals come through the door, it might be too much for Les to resist.
Les has finally heard enough from Seth and Ashley about his bum watch band deal and bets that he can sell them off just to get the kids off his back and Ashley turns barber for a day.

Following the quirky day-to-day operations of American Jewelry and Loan, a family-owned and operated pawn shop in Detroit, Michigan. This time, Seth and Ashley start the day with a wager that leaves one of them dressed to the nines.

Ashley is livid when she gets cut out of a deal by Les and Seth. Trying to keep the peace and the business running smoothly, Les separates the siblings, but the battle spills onto the sales floor in a huge way.
The sibling rivalry between Seth and Ashley is at an all-time high and when Ashley faces down not one, but two baseball deals that are clearly outside her comfort zone, Seth cries foul.
Brawling isn't exactly out of the ordinary at American Jewelry and Loan, but when customers start throwing down in the car park before the doors even open, Les knows it's a bad sign.

Angry over his father's dismissal of the consultant hired to help increase their sales, Seth goes MIA, leaving the store in the lurch. When he doesn't come back, Les goes looking and is shocked at where he finds his son spending his time.

Les is devastated when he suspects Seth of doing deals behind his back with a competitor, Ashley gets spooked by a skeleton rock band, Bobby J tosses the pigskin for a big win, and a vintage Dick Tracy radio pops up.

Les and Ashley get reeled in by the world's largest fishing lure, but Seth thinks it will be a tough sell. Things get physical when Byron is pushed too far and Les squares off with a hot headed hillbilly.
Ashley smells weed in the warehouse, and the hunt is on to discover who is getting high at work. Les offers a cash reward for information and Seth plans to drug test the employees.

Les is always on the lookout for deals, but when he hears about a hook-up for truckloads of brand-new goods, he makes a move that could change the store forever. Later, Seth takes a spin on a bar stool racer.

When Seth needs help in the online department, Les volunteers Ashley who immediately oversteps by putting a rare Olympic torch from Seth's personal collection up for sale. When the item goes MIA, all hell breaks loose with the store's reputation.

After tearing through the online department, Ashley has to face the consequences when her rash instruction leads to the destruction of an important shipment. Seth takes a ride in a hovercraft, and Les does business with Muhammad Ali Jr.

When Ashley snags a deal away from Les right under his nose, the family decides to hold a father-daughter sales competition, with Seth as the judge. Bobby J goes for a dangerous ride he won't soon forget.

When Seth has just five minutes to bid on a valuable sports card auction, he takes a shot without telling his Dad. But when the big boss finds out he spent thousands without a word, Les throws down the gauntlet.

After spending a fortune on sports memorabilia, Seth comes down to the wire to sell it all before his Dad's deadline, or else he'll be out thousands of dollars. Plus, Les checks out a sweet Starfire Convertible.
A valuable guitar strikes a special chord in Seth, a customer comes by the shop and tries to buy a fancy watch with some questionable coin and Les does a deal with his doppelgänger.
When the security guards start spooking customers, the Les sends them home to teach them a lesson. Yet when some angry customers make outrageous demands, and the Golds have to fend for themselves.

Dealers Michael Hogben, Brenda Haller, David Tupman and Simon Schneider are in Stoke-on-Trent. Amongst the items of interest are an Asprey's silver chamberstick, a 1950s Wilson pram and a quirky gaming dice.

David and dealers Mark Stevens, Corrie Jeffrey and David Hackney are in Oldham, to celebrate the 600th show in the series. Items of interest include a unique set of SAS medals, and a world-famous conductor's baton.
Skipton is the location today as Cheryl Hakeney gets herself in a spin over an Art Deco bronze figure, other items brought along include a Royal Doulton Toby jug, and a cavalier sword.
Burton-on-Trent is the location today as a naive marine painting comes through the door, and there are some saucy postcards that make Jo Brayshaw chuckle.

Two scout teams attempt gruelling journeys to reach a signal tower. One team struggles to crest a jungle ridgeline, and the other takes on 12 miles of Lost Coast seas. And a survivalist slips out of consciousness.

Homesteading has exploded in popularity, with families moving to more remote areas and with bigger ambition than ever before. But for the rookie off-gridder striving for self-sufficiency, extreme plans often lead to extreme problems.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

A dream leads John to a crab hotspot, but a rival trawler shares the vision for filling its own massive nets. Keith's crew races to save the Wizard as seawater breaches the engine room.
Howie Mandel wants the team to build another tank. This time it is a surprise for his manager's company and there is an existing tank needs a seriously major upgrade.
Pianoworks in New York wants Wayde and Brett to build them their own piano-shaped tank made from acrylic. The team have a lot of work ahead of them if they are to hit the right note.

pr.t: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
pr.d: In North America's most extreme goldfields, thousands of unprepared miners gamble it all, chasing the highest gold prices in history -- and find themselves on the brink of ruin. Their last hope: Freddy and Juan.
The skipper of the Northwestern goes all 'Moby Dick' in his hunt for the fabled blue king crab. As a storm closes in, his crew start to doubt his sanity.
Time Bandit heads into False Pass to a crab offloading spot, but in the midst of storms and sandbars they're close to sinking. Can they make it through safely?
Wardens hunt down an alligator poacher who has been bragging online; Wardens search for drug smugglers while pulling illegal nets out of the river.
Texas Game Wardens go on an undercover mission to put a stop to a wild animal black market; oil spill threatens wildlife in Galveston; robotic deer decoy is utilised in catching night poachers.
How do they make pistachios, what is the Forbidden City, and how do they produce radars? Find out as more items are put under the microscope.
How do they build wrecker trucks, how do they produce Roquefort, and how are trees transported? Find out as more items are examined.
How do they produce marble, how do they make mah-jong pieces, and how do they build escape slides? Find out as more items are put under the microscope.
An insight into the production and manufacturing process of Kamaz trucks, hair care products, and the Canton Tower.
The Dagues moved to Michigan's wilderness. But they have no power, predators killed their chickens and all their water must be hand-pumped from a well.
The Raneys return to Alaska, but they find their homestead in complete disrepair. They race to build a steel tram before the deep freeze sets in again.
Mike finds a 1992 Corrado G60 smothered in a number of aftermarket mods and repairs it within the budget of £8,000.
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores. After reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

Josh dives the deadly, frigid waters of the Baltic Sea in search of a revolutionary Nazi submarine: the V-80. Hitler ordered it scuttled to prevent the Allies from learning its secrets. Now, Josh risks it all to bring the prototype to the surface.
Bruce Crompton marks the 75th Anniversary of VE Day, sending rare German half-track vehicles to partake in a battle re-enactment. In France, he seeks VE Day relics.

pr.t: Alice im Wunderland: Hinter den Spiegeln
pr.d: Alice verbringt Jahre damit, zur See zu fahren. Als sie wieder in London ankommt, stößt sie auf einen magischen Spiegel. So kehrt sie wieder zurück in das Reich von Unterland und trifft dort auf ihre Freunde, das weiße Kaninchen, Absolem, die Grinsekatze und den verrückten Hutmacher, der aber nicht mehr er selbst zu sein scheint. Deshalb schickt die Weiße Königin Alice auf eine Mission, um den "Chronosphäre" von Zeit zu leihen und damit in die Vergangenheit zu reisen, um alles zu richten.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.
Als Chip und Chap ihre Ideen in Mickys Flitzerlabor einfließen lassen, spielen die Flitzer verrückt.

Beim ersten Treffen ihres Buchklubs in Pennsylvania liest Vampirina versehentlich aus einem magischen Buch vor, das Chaos anrichtet. Die Mädchen hecken einen Spukplan aus, um mögliche Interessenten davon abzuhalten, Poppys Haus zu kaufen.

Gerade als die große Frosch-Talentshow beginnen soll, versagt Daisys Stimme. Um das drohende Desaster abzuwenden, eilen ihre Freunde ihr sofort zu Hilfe. Sie besorgen Zitrone und Honig für einen heilenden Tee, der ihren Auftritt retten soll.

Papa fährt mit Bluey und Bingo in den Park. Bluey freut sich riesig und kann es kaum erwarten, endlich auf das Klettergerüst zu steigen. Doch ihre Geduld wird auf die Probe gestellt, weil Papa anhält, um sich mit anderen Erwachsenen zu unterhalten.

Bluey hat einen eigenen Taxiservice und schon ihren ersten Fahrgast: ihren Vater. Der ist Geschäftsmann und muss ganz dringend zum Flughafen. Doch leider hat Bluey nicht mit allen Verzögerungen gerechnet und nun könnte Papa seinen Flug verpassen.

Mama geht alleine am Strand spazieren, doch Bluey möchte ihr eine Muschel zeigen und rennt ihr hinterher. Zum ersten Mal ist sie alleine unterwegs und folgt Mamas Fußspuren. Dabei macht Bluey einige spannende Begegnungen.
Bluey, Bingo und eine Freundin spielen Piraten auf einer Hängematte, wo sie Abenteuer erleben.

Das Spidey-Team muss verhindern, dass der helle Leuchtturm vom Grünen Kobold allen den Schlaf raubt. Ein Strandtag wird von Sandmann unterbrochen, der beweisen will, dass er der Beste im Sandburgenbauen ist.

Sofias erster Tag an der königlichen Zauberschule ist extrem aufregend. Sie schließt sich mit neuen Freunden zusammen, um ein spannendes Rennen zu gewinnen. Dabei erhält sie einen ganz besonderen, magischen Besuch von Prinzessin Rapunzel.

Darly, Loomis und ihre Freunde erleben epische Abenteuer auf einer magischen Insel. Gemeinsam entdecken sie eine bunte Welt voller Fantasie und meistern jede Herausforderung mit echtem Teamgeist. Sei gespannt auf die tollen Eindrücke!

Phil und Claire verlassen beide ihre Komfortzone: Während er auf einen Überlebenscampingausflug geht, fährt sie zum ersten Mal einen Sattelschlepper. Unterdessen ist Gloria empört über Mannys Verhältnis mit seiner Professorin.

Jay fühlt sich für seinen Beitrag in der Firma nicht ausreichend gewürdigt. Phil steht unter Druck, endlich wieder ein Haus zu verkaufen, bekommt es aber mit einer schwierigen Kundin zu tun. Luke und Alex handeln mit einer besonderen Ware.
Dharma und Greg wollen die Feiertage auf den Bahamas verbringen. Wegen eines Sturms müssen sie in Indiana notlanden und dort ist sich Dharma gar nicht sicher, ob sie noch auf die Bahamas will.
Kitty schenkt Greg eine Kreuzfahrt in die Karibik, doch Ed soll auch dabei sein. Dharma bereitet ein sehr ungewöhnliches Geschenk für Greg vor.
Abby ist eine absolute Tierliebhaberin, doch dann findet sie heraus, dass Greg und Edward gern angeln. Weil sie gern einen Angelausflug machen wollen, wirft Greg sie aus Haus Finkelstein raus.

Weil Coach ihm vorwirft, dass er in der Beziehung mit Jess seine Männlichkeit verliert, beschließt Nick, zu Thanksgiving campen zu gehen. Da Jess aber möchte, dass alle an dem Feiertag zusammen essen, kommt die ganze WG inklusive Cece mit zum Campen. Doch das Essen gestaltet sich schwieriger als gedacht, weil Nick nichts mitgebracht hat, sondern darauf besteht, dass sie alles selbst jagen und sammeln.

Jess erhält ein neues Jobangebot und muss sich in nur 20 Minuten entscheiden, ob sie ihre Arbeit als Lehrerin an den Nagel hängt oder nicht. Das bringt ihre Freunde dazu, selbst darüber nachzudenken, wie sie zu ihren jeweiligen Jobs gekommen sind.

Mrs. Münzberg weilt in ihrem Chalet hoch in den Bergen und ist an Jodelfieber erkrankt. Mrs. Münzberg entdeckt ihre Idole im Country Club. Als Bentley eine riesige Katzenstatue auf den Kopf fällt, benimmt er sich wie eine Katze.
Beni muss diesmal versuchen, mit einer besonderen Mülltonne ein Pferd zu überholen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Ein Film wird gerade gedreht, der Ladybug und Cat Noir in Verruf bringt und alles verändern könnte.

Liff hat fünf Mächte des Chaos entfesselt. Nur Helen kann ihr jetzt noch helfen. Gleichzeitig steht Liff eine schwierige Diskussion mit Barry bevor, denn es geht um die Fertigstellung von Martins OJ. Wie wird das Gespräch ausgehen?

Cricket lässt Gloria mit der Arbeit im Café alleine, denn er will die Fünfzehn-Minuten-Pause dafür nutzen, die Parade zu sehen. Bill nutzt einen Ausflug zum Baumarkt, um Remy eine Lektion in Eigenständigkeit zu erteilen.

pr.t: Mystery Lane - Ein Fall für Clever und Bro
pr.d: Der Papagei des Archäologen Arthur Bones bittet Clever um Hilfe, als sein Herr entführt wird.

Auf der Insel gibt es eine neue Hip-Hop-Hula-Gruppe und Lilo möchte beitreten. Mertle gibt ihr aber nicht viel Hoffnung, da die Gruppe voll reicher Kinder ist. Um Eindruck zu schinden, zieht sich Lilo poppig an und besucht die Gruppe. Sie erzählt, dass sie aus einer reichen Familie kommt. Lilo beauftragt Stitch, Pliiklii und Jumba, das neueste Experiment einzufangen: "Bö", ein kleiner Blasebalg, der Orkane erzeugt.

Ein Zug wird entführt und rast entlang der amerikanisch-kanadischen Grenze. Agent P muss sich mit seiner ehemaligen Partnerin Lyla zusammentun, um die Passagiere des Zuges zu retten, die Mission zu meistern, Doofenshmirtz zu besiegen und Kanadas nationales Kulturgut, einen Elch namens Albert, zu bewahren.
Bluey und Bingo gehen erst zu ihrer Spielstunde mit Judo, wenn die Gummiechse von der Decke fällt.
Bingo ist eine vorbildliche Bürgerin. Bluey hingegen interessiert sich nur dafür, Spaß zu haben.
Bingo und Bluey wechseln sich damit ab, die Königin und ihr treuer Diener zu sein.
Bluey und Bingo benutzen Verpackungen und Luftpolsterfolie, um ihre eigene Zivilisation zu bauen.
Bluey und Bingo wollen eine besondere Überraschung vorbereiten. Sie eröffnen ein Restaurant.

Als die Väter im Garten Baumstümpfe ausreißen, verwandeln Bluey, Bingo und Muffin einen Baumstumpf in einen Nagelsalon. Als es an der Zeit ist, den Stumpf der Mädchen herauszureißen, müssen die Väter einen Deal aushandeln.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Der Waisenjunge Tarzan wächst in der abgelegenen afrikanischen Wildnis auf, aufgezogen von dem sanften Gorilla Kala. Als eine britische Expedition den Dschungel betritt, begegnet Tarzan der schönen Jane und erkennt, dass er wie sie ein Mensch ist. Tarzan verliebt sich in Jane und ist hin- und hergerissen zwischen dem Leben in der Zivilisation und dem Aufenthalt bei seiner Gorillafamilie, die von dem rücksichtslosen Jäger Clayton bedroht wird.

Zusammen mit Äffchen Abu macht der Straßenjunge Aladdin die Gassen der Basare unsicher. Aber er träumt von einem besseren Leben. Vor allem seit er Jasmin, die Tochter des Sultans, kennengelernt hat. Plötzlich ändert sich Aladdins Leben schlagartig, denn er gelangt in den Besitz einer Wunderlampe, die es wirklich in sich hat: Sie beherbergt einen gigantischen, unendlich ausgeflippten Flaschengeist namens Dschinni, der seinem Besitzer drei Wünsche erfüllen kann.

Olaf schlüpft in die Rolle von Aladdin aus dem gleichnamigen Film und erzählt seine Geschichte nach. Der Schneemann wird sogar zum magischen, wunscherfüllenden Dschinn, aber auch zum skrupellosen Großwesir Jafar mit seinem Handlanger Jago.

Percy Jackson wird beschuldigt, einen Mitschüler während eines Ausflugs angegriffen zu haben, woraufhin er von der Schule verwiesen wird. Infolgedessen offenbart seine Mutter Sally ihm zu Hause, dass er ein Halbgott ist und von Monstern gejagt wird.

Percy sucht im Camp Half-Blood Halt, während er mit dem Verschwinden seiner Mutter kämpft. Dort muss er zwischen Freunden und Feinden unterscheiden. Infolgedessen spielt er ein Spiel, das seine Herkunft und sein gefährliches Vermächtnis offenbart.

Schmidt hat durch sein Geständnis Cece und Elizabeth verloren. Deswegen setzt er alles daran, Nicks und Jess' Beziehung zu sabotieren. Nick hat Probleme, über seine Gefühle zu sprechen. Winston versucht, seinem Kater zu Liebesfreuden zu verhelfen.

Nick kommt unerwartet zu Geld und gerät in einen Streit mit Jess, die ganz eigene Vorstellungen hat, wofür Nick das Geld verwenden soll. Schmidt versucht, ein guter Mensch zu sein und holt sich Ratschläge von seinem Rabbi. Doch als er diese Ratschläge befolgt, kommt er zu einer ganz anderen Erkenntnis.

Jess macht sich Sorgen um Schmidt, der immer mehr in Selbstmitleid versinkt und nicht mehr er selbst ist. Um ihn wieder zur Vernunft zu bringen, schreibt sie Schmidt einen gefälschten Brief von seinem Idol Michael Keaton.

India: Michael travels to India to uncover how the British East India Company - the world's first multinational corporation - raised a private army to create an empire. S1 Ep1
Jamaica: Michael visits Jamaica, the Caribbean capital of the Empire, heading to Fort Charles where the Empire enlisted the help of pirates to defend the new territory from the Spanish. S1 Ep2
South Africa: Michael travels to South Africa to explore how the lure of riches led Britain into barbaric wars, dividing the country along racial lines with devastating consequences. S1 Ep3

Zambia: Fly above the far-western reaches of the Zambezi, experience the largest mammal migration on earth, and explore Victoria Falls, the largest waterfall on the planet. S1 Ep7
Mozambique: Explore palm-fringed sands, parks and seafaring traditions, and discover the melting pot of African, Arabic and Portuguese traditions in one of Africa's most enigmatic countries. S1 Ep8
Cameroon: Fly over the spectacular landscapes of this sovereign nation renowned for its diversity, from the breathtaking coastal regions on the Atlantic to the shores of Lake Ossa. S1 Ep9
Botswana: Explore the landscapes of Botswana, from the salt pans of the Makgadikgadi, over the maze of marshlands and floodplains of the Okavango Delta, to the Kalahari desert. S1 Ep10
Reno To The Napa Valley: Michael Portillo travels from Reno, Nevada to California's Napa County, taking to the skies over the Sierra Nevada mountain range. S3 Ep1
San Francisco: Michael Portillo's journey's to San Francisco, where he travels through the city's streets by cable car, before heading across the bay to Sausalito. S3 Ep2
Berkeley to Santa Cruz: Michael Portillo visits Yosemite National Park in California, beholding its granite cliffs, sequoia trees and waterfalls. S3 Ep3
Monterey to Los Angeles: In the port of Monterey, Michael Portillo discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage. S3 Ep4
Los Angeles to San Diego: Michael Portillo discovers the secrets of backyard oil drilling in Los Angeles and joins the locals for Mexican Independence Day. S3 Ep5
Boston to Concord: Michael Portillo visits Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, learning how surgery was first made bearable in 1846 by a miraculous new substance. S3 Ep6
Plymouth to New London: Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, where he learns about the indigenous tribes of Wampanoag people. S3 Ep7
New Haven to Plattsburgh: Michael Portillo's rail voyage continues through Connecticut heading north through the scenic New England states, where he takes a crash course in rowing. S3 Ep8

Alfonso Tellado, xubilado da Bazán e galego retranqueiro, viaxa por distintos lugares de Galicia para coñecer de preto as vivencias, costumes e labores de diferentes colectivos e veciños.
Esta praza abriu as súas portas en 1935 e un dos seus elementos máis característicos é o rianxo, nome que se lle da aos produtos da horta que traen a vender á praza as mesmas persoas que o cultivan.

Best friends Yuvraj and Gurnoor fall for the same girl, Noor, and soon begin trying different ways to win her heart, turning their friendship into a fun and emotional challenge.

The two winning chefs from the Wales region must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges and guest judge Dan Bloxham, 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon's Master of Ceremonies.

Pip Lacey's starter is a humorous take on the unpredictable British weather and features an unusual presentation. Ryan Simpson's dish represents an allotment complete with soil, while Nick Deverell-Smith's creation is a tribute to the precision cutting of 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon's grass.

With the chefs hoping to impress, they each take risks. Pip Lacey combines lobster with strawberry in a tribute to strawberries and cream. Ryan Simpson's also using lobster in his recreation of a BBQ and has invented a technique to create his chips.

Ryan Simpson hopes to elevate a ploughman's lunch into a gourmet affair, Pip Lacey pays tribute to an unusual 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon icon, while Nick Deverell-Smith looks to celebrate a meat which he thinks is underused, venison.

Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges. Pip Lacey's pineapple dessert uses coriander. Nick Deverell-Smith also pays tribute to the pineapple, creating a dessert featuring a rice pudding made with couscous.

The two chefs who've made it through cook their four courses again. They must impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver and guest judge Jordanne Whiley, one of Britain's most successful wheelchair tennis players.

The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. Eddie is hoping to do better than last year, Joery is hoping to impress with a tribute to Richard Krajicek, and Tommy is creating a warm salad.

Joery Castel is combining mackerel and cucumber, and Tommy Heaney hopes his Murray Mound is a fitting tribute to Andy Murray's love of sushi. Eddie Attwell is creating five different strawberry elements to accompany the scallops in his dish.
Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.
Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.

The two chefs who have made it through cook their four courses again. They are hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges, Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver, who are joined by tennis's greatest entertainer, Mansour Bahrami.

With finals week ahead of them, judge Andi Oliver first summons the chefs to 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon to have a look at where they could be cooking if they win. The judges are joined by guest judge Sue Barker, host of the 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon coverage for more than 20 years.

The chefs must cook their fish courses but with some exceptionally high scoring dishes in the regional heats, each chef will need to deliver perfection in order to see off the competition. The judges are joined by guest judge Tim Henman.

It is main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. As the barbecues are fired up, all eight chefs are feeling the heat. The judges are joined by guest judge Gordon Reid.

It is dessert day and with just one place remaining at the 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon banquet, each chef is giving everything they have got. The judges are joined by guest judge Annabel Croft, former British number one and Junior 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon champion.
It's the grand finale and the winning chefs must now cook their dishes at the banquet. Once in the kitchen, the chefs face the huge challenge of scaling up their dishes.

Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred 'House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.
The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred 'The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from 'The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango purée filled doughnuts for his dessert 'Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.
The two remaining London and the south-east chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they remake their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision, gained from working at two-Michelin-starred restaurant 'Andrew Fairlie'.

It is the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross seeks victory with his dish 'Lobster Aid'. Lorna's 'Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements.

Ross is hoping to impress with 'Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

Ross is attempting to elevate a classic into a dish worthy of the banquet, Lorna is cooking a personal tribute to NHS staff using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours, and Ben is serving an experimental dish which includes a beeswax ice cream.

It is judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's 'Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's 'For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with 'Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

A look at how psychic energy gathers at the scene of life-or-death crises, a psychiatric hospital with a reputation for being haunted, and a nurse who describes the spirits she sees walking her hospital's halls.

Teenager Annabeth gets a tour of an ageing psychiatric facility and finds the rumours about the building being haunted are true. Meanwhile, Nurse Leanne discovers she has the ability to see the spirits that walk the halls of her hospital.

A look at spirits intent on punishing the living, featuring a nighttime intruder at a nursing home, a vengeful ghost who appears before a nurse's aide, and an aggressive entity that targets a switchboard operator.
Three friends experience the supernatural in different ways, with different responses to the strange things they've seen.
A paramedic is haunted by the restless spirit of a dead Army officer; a security guard encounters a demonic presence while investigating an abandoned hospital ward.
A paramedic examines reports of furious spirits in a former animal testing lab, while another goes to a rural house where a woman is on the verge of passing away.
A prison guard encounters an invisible attacker. A rookie police officer goes to an empty nursing home after receiving an emergency call.
Lesley is traumatised when her father doesn't believe she's seen a ghost, while young Lance's family takes it in their stride when he sees a phantom in an old dormitory.
Two people who have been to the other side tell of the supernatural experiences surrounding their own deaths.
Barbara and Elsie both get ghostly messages from their long-dead fathers, and those messages save their mothers' lives.
Alex turns to Catholic icons for safety when he is faced with horrifying supernatural threats. Meanwhile, Susan goes to unusual lengths to keep her protective rosary close.
Their spouses died, but didn't leave. Fred and Pansy continue to have a ghostly relationship with their dead wife and husband.
They both drowned as children and both were revived. And ever since, Karyn and Douglas have been able to see and talk to ghosts.

A young woman fights a battle with the demons that threaten to kill her. Anorexia and the grisly apparition of an old hag have plagued her nightly for six years, leaving her dangerously sleep-deprived, and emotionally scarred.
The story of a woman who is followed by the evil spirit of a bootlegger. Felicia Sills finds a Civil War-era ring.
A man shares his story of a monster attack. The story of a couple who experienced violent paranormal activity. Holly shares her story of being haunted be her ex-husband's ghost.
A women's son is put in danger's way; a young boy is terrorised by a shadowy figure; Micky faces an evil spirit.

After Waverly Hills' long-time caretakers return to the historic tuberculosis hospital, APRA is invited to investigate claims of the `homecoming effect', as paranormal activity reports spike upon their re-entry into the building.

The team meets with a living descendant from Rose Mont, a historic Tennessee thoroughbred horse farm, to investigate whether multiple generations of his ancestors are responsible for its purported ghostly activity.
APRA delves into the dark history and violent paranormal claims surrounding Brushy Mountain, Tennessee's first maximum security prison, infamous for its ominous nickname 'End of the Line'.

The team's exploration into hospital phenomena brings them to Harriman, where a site recently acquired by a tight-knit group of longtime investigators is being visited by individuals attempting to reconnect with their deceased loved ones.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: Henry and Simon are in Buckinghamshire to visit a repair shop. Henry finds a table that is perfect for an imaginative project he's been planning for a while and a club fender.
How do they drill through a kilometre of solid rock, pick 20,000 oranges a minute for juice, and get glass to curve without cracking.
Drew Pritchard and Alister Dryburgh visit three promising new antique trade contacts who they've been tipped off about.
Angus discovers an eccentric haul of curios at Dom Joly's regency townhouse. Plus, Lizzie Cundy gets Angus blushing with an array of slinky party frocks.
Drew and Viki hunt down surprising and desirable items. They visit a classic car collection in Durham and a favourite dealer in Edinburgh.
A huge haul of silver leaves Angus speechless and raises a staggering amount at auction. Later, Angus helps Susan clear a huge collection of railwayana.
Fiat 130 Coupe & Mercedes SL. Paul has an epic restoration on his hands when Drew buys an automotive design classic, a Fiat 130 coupe, that has a serious corrosion problem.
In the southwest, Tahmina and David home in on exotic antiques, including Chinese silk and Indian tea paraphernalia. Will they dazzle at auction.
How do they make steel wool, ranges, carved candles, and slot machines? Find out as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Henry and Fuzz are in Surrey visiting classic cars and tractor collector Ross. Will they go for a gangster-style Rover or a 1920s Renault saloon.
How do they make airline meals, paper cups, trumpets, and semiconductors? Find out as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Henry and Fuzz return to Surrey to visit collectors Nick and Hollie, who have an incredible array of cars including a 1921 Rolls Royce Silver Ghost.
Teleshopping.

Hitler forgoes his pact with Stalin and invades Russia with the mission to destroy the whole population and gain land in Eastern Europe for his supreme race.

The Nazi regime lasted from 1933 to 1945 and was one of the most horrific periods of history. However, Adolf Hitler was not working alone. He had a circle of some of the most barbaric men alongside him, who helped make the atrocities possible.

pr.t: Mein Kampf: The Secrets of Hitler's Books
pr.d: Adolf Hitler's "Mein Kampf" is one of the most widely read political manifestos in the history of mankind and, at the same time, one of the most terrible. Revealing the secrets of his sinister work.

pr.t: The Strange World of the German Dictator
pr.d: Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.
For the 80th anniversary of Britain's darkest hour Dan Snow visits the House of Commons to learn about the speeches that turned the tide of WWII.
Historians analyse the Battle for Stalingrad, focusing on Hitler and Stalin, as well as their respective generals Paulus and Zhukov's campaigns.

pr.t: Inside the Mind of Vladimir Putin
pr.d: Vladimir Putin is the modern face of dictatorship, rising out of the ashes of the chaotic Yeltsin years. In the 90s, Putin was a relatively unknown figure who would go on to occupy an untouchable position in a country spanning 11 time zones.

pr.t: Saddam Hussein - Rule & Misrule in Iraq
pr.d: Saddam Hussein, born in 1937, fled oppression as the Ba'ath Party rose in post-WWII Iraq and Syria.

pr.t: Pol Pot - The Khymer Rouge & The Killing Fields
pr.d: Pol Pot, born in Brecksville, Cambodia in the 1920s, was influenced by Cambodia's history.
The reasons why one-time Man of the Year Pierre Laval collaborated with the Nazi regime, sending Jewish people to the Nazi death camps.

To some, Chaim Rumkowski is considered a man of immense courage, to others, a traitor. Because of him, 7,000 members of the Łódź ghetto survived, but he was also a Jew who worked with the Nazis for his own benefit and assisted in the Final Solution.
Viktor Arajs formed a Latvian commando unit that hunted Jews.

If Léon Degrelle, a writer and journalist, had lived in another era, then he could have been a hero and a leader. However, he became a supporter of Hitler and ended up betraying his faith, his country and his people.
Umberto 'Albert' Anastasia, once the chief of the notorious 'Murder Incorporated' crime firm, winds up the target of a mob hit in a barber shop chair.

pr.d: Henning Franzmeier and his team of archaeologists continue their search for the truth about Ramses the Great's lost city, uncovering new secrets and fascinating finds.
The prime suspect of a gruesome triple homicide, wax sculptor Robert Irwin, sold his story to finance his defence and escape the death penalty.
With a double indemnity insurance policy on her husband's life and a lover as an accomplice, what can go wrong with Ruthie Brown's plan to stage a murder?
Archaeological finds from Roman Britannia include 97 baby skeletons buried near the Thames, a town in rural Devon, and a Roman cult figure that remained buried beneath a fort for 1700 years.

The team are on the hunt for archaeology from the more recent past as they follow the search for artefacts from World War II. They join marine archaeologists in the Solent as they raise the once-in-a-lifetime find of a Fairey Barracuda dive bomber. More than 2,500 Barracudas were in service during the war but not a single complete plane survives today. Naoíse Mac Sweeney joins the post excavation to reveal how the find could help bring this rare aircraft back to life.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.
Rick Edwards and Beau Ouimette look for evidence of Roman life in Scotland, heading to Ardoch Fort in Perthshire, on the east bank of the River Knaik.
The River Hunters search the Cork Beck river in north Yorkshire, which runs close to the location of one of the bloodiest battles to take place on British soil.
When Pharaoh Ptolemy IV confronts Antiochus the Great at Raphia, 100,000 men from the Mediterranean clash in a battle that uses military and naval strategies inspired by Alexander the Great.

Cleopatra attempts to restore the power of the early pharaohs through alliances with the most powerful men in the world. Her clash with Octavian at the battle of Actium leads to the rise of an emperor.
In Cheltenham, Britain's most Regency town, Professor Alice Roberts attends a period society ball, investigates social hierarchy and explores the Regency fondness for enemas.
In Belfast, the UK's most Victorian city, Alice Roberts visits the shipyards that built the Titanic, gets locked up in the Crumlin Road gaol and learns about 19th-century etiquette.
Andy tracks down the site of the original Stonehenge, meets a childhood witness of Wales' most famous UFO incident and takes part in a comedic hunt for the Welsh Wildman.
Andy heads to the home of palaeontology on the Jurassic Coast and braves the collapsing cliffs of Lyme Regis to bring back one of its many fossils.
Alice discovers things at Norwich Castle Museum which highlight facts about Tudor life, Anglo-Saxon childbirth rituals, and the Pompeii of the Bronze Age.
A look back at the best archaeological findings of 2014, including the Barrow Clump, Ipplepen and Winchester sites.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.

Kevin Sempé explores the bay of Saint-Pierre in Martinique, where ships smouldered and sank following the devastating volcanic eruption of 1902.

Feuerwehrmann Luke und seine Frau Emily sind auf dem Weg zum Abendessen und halten noch an einer Tankstelle, wo Emily ein Powerball-Lotterielos kauft - und das junge Paar um eine Million Dollar reicher macht! Nun können sie ihr winziges Mietshaus.

Der liebevolle Partner David unterstützte Luke in einer persönlichen Krise, doch die Folgen haben ihr kleines Stadthaus überfordert. Das Team kam zu Hilfe, um es in einen retro- und vielseitigen Zufluchtsort für Entertainer zu verwandeln.

Die Anforderungen der Elternschaft haben Holly und Darren an den Rand der Zerreißprobe gebracht und ihr Zuhause im Chaos versinken lassen. Das Team kommt zu Hilfe, um es in einen Zufluchtsort für Holly, Darren und ihre beiden Kinder zu verwandeln.

Nick besucht in Portsmouth drei Generationen in einer sehr engen Wohnung. Er hilft beim Aufräumen, sortiert Omas Andenken und Mamas Backzeug. Zwischen Erinnerungen und Alltagsgegenständen entdeckt er Familiengeschichten.

Nick macht sich auf den Weg nach Bolton im Großraum Manchester, um eine Familie zu treffen, die in einer Vierzimmer-Doppelhaushälfte lebt, die von Bergen von Gerümpel überwältigt ist. Mutter Nikkis Entspannungstherapie hat die Oberhand gewonnen.

Die Holmes-Familie unterstützt ihren Freund Frank, der wegen gesundheitlicher Probleme mit seiner Renovierung kämpft. Währenddessen bringt Mike die Farbwahl eines Bungalows an seine Grenzen, als er die kreativen Designentscheidungen hinterfragt.

Kristen und Joe träumen davon, in der Nähe eines Bergurlaubsgebietes zu wohnen, und wünschen sich ein Haus in der Gegend von Denver, Colorado. Mit einem Budget von 150.000 Dollar suchen sie nach einem Minihaus in der Nähe von Ski- und Wandermöglichkeiten. Sie sind bereit, sich zu verkleinern, um in dieser beliebten Gegend wohnen zu können. Um diesen Traum wahrzumachen, müssen sie allerdings einige Annehmlichkeiten des modernen Lebens opfern.

Nachdem sie ihr Restaurant in San Diego, Kalifornien, verkauft hat, ist Elena bereit, ein neues Geschäft zu eröffnen und ein ganz neues Leben anzufangen. Sie sucht nach einem modernen Minihaus in der lebhaften Stadt Asheville in North Carolina, das auch Platz bietet, um Gäste zu empfangen. Elena hat aber nur ein schmales Budget von 50.000 Dollar für das Haus und das Grundstück, auf dem es stehen soll.

Der Musiker Mark will ein einfacheres Leben führen und von einem über 250 Quadratmeter großen Anwesen in Nashville, Tennessee, in ein Minihaus in Santa Barbara, Kalifornien, umziehen. Er möchte weniger Zeit für die Instandhaltung eines großen Hauses verwenden und stattdessen mehr Musik machen. Es wird sich zeigen, ob er tatsächlich in der Lage ist, die Annehmlichkeiten seines Anwesens für ein pflegeleichteres Minihaus aufzugeben.

Tracy, deren erwachsene Kinder ihr eigenes Leben führen, spürt den Drang zu reisen. Sie will ihr Leben radikal vereinfachen und möchte in und um die kanadische Provinz Alberta dorthin gehen, wo es ihr gefällt. Ihre pragmatische Tochter Lindsay will allerdings dafür sorgen, dass ihre Mutter auf dem Teppich bleibt. Gemeinsam suchen sie nach einem modernen mobilen Häuschen, in dem genügend Platz ist, damit Tracy mit ihrem Enkel spielen kann.

Gary und Becky sind Professoren. Sie haben ein Semester in Vietnam verbracht. Die Zeit dort hat ihnen außerordentlich gut gefallen. Als sie wieder zurückkehren, fällen sie daher einen Entschluss: Sie wollen nach Ho-Chi-Minh-Stadt auswandern.

Eine junge Familie zieht wegen des Jobs von Kanada nach Wellington in Neuseeland. Die Mutter macht sich jedoch große Sorgen um ihre Zwillingstöchter. Denn die beiden müssen jetzt ohne den großen familiären Rückhalt aufwachsen.

Eine Familie mit vier Kindern beschließt, von Missouri nach Italien auszuwandern. Doch die Eltern sind sich noch nicht einig, wohin genau es gehen soll. Der Vater bevorzugt Bologna. Doch die Mutter hat eine andere Vorstellung.

Gina und Stephan sind frisch verheiratet. Sie haben geplant, nach Madrid zu ziehen. Von dort aus wollen sie ganz Europa bereisen. Nun stellt sich die Frage nach dem genauen Wohnort. Gina möchte gerne in die pulsierende Innenstadt ziehen.

Ein introvertierter Mann möchte seine Komfortzone verlassen und nach Melbourne umziehen. Seine Ehefrau hat bereits auf der ganzen Welt gelebt. Sie freut sich über den neuen Mut ihres Mannes und so machen sich dich beiden auf in ihr Abenteuer.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Die Pensionärin Kathy und ihr Sohn Gene leben in Kalifornien und wollen zurück in ihre alte Heimat im Süden. Mit einem Rubbellos wird ihr Traum wahr, und sie suchen ein geräumiges Haus mit großem Grundstück außerhalb von Montgomery, Alabama.

Carla kauft ein Los für zwei Dollar und ist wenig später um eine Million reicher. Jetzt will sie ihre Mietwohnung in Omaha gegen ein Eigenheim in Fremont, Nebraska, eintauschen, um näher bei ihrer Familie zu sein. Sie sucht ein Haus mit viel Platz.
Drew versucht, das Budget einer Familie mit ihrer Wunschliste in Einklang zu bringen.
Sandy, Phil und ihr Baby sind aus ihrer Wohnung herausgewachsen und suchen ein neues Zuhause.

Jamie und Emily haben ihre Familienurlaube früher an der Küste von New Jersey verbracht. Nun wollen sie sich hier eine Immobilie kaufen. Sie gehen in Atlantic City auf die Suche. Die Immobilie darf aber nicht zu viel kosten.

Matt und Megan sind über Jahre mit ihren Kindern nach Emerald Isle gefahren. Nun möchten sie dort eine eigene Immobilie kaufen und aus ihr ein Feriendomizil machen. Dafür steht ihnen ein Budget von 50.000 € zur Verfügung.

Auf Fripp Island, South Carolina, finden Jim und Sarah ein Haus mit faszinierendem Meerblick. Bei der Renovierung verpassen sie der Immobilie eine neue Küche, reißen Wände heraus und ersetzen die alten Fenster durch größere.

Tamara Day kauft außerhalb von Kansas City ein großes Landhaus von 1988 mit 409 m². Auf zwei Ebenen verteilen sich vier Schlafzimmer und vier Bäder. Immobilien kosten in dieser Gegend über eine halbe Mio. Dollar: Tamara erwarb es für 360.000.

Tamara Day gestaltet ein hundert Jahre altes Shirtwaist-Haus um, wobei sie die ursprüngliche Holzvertäfelung hervorhebt. Außerdem beschließt sie, die kleine Küche ins Esszimmer zu verlegen. Die Renovierungsarbeiten kosten sie viel Kraft.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Im Tropenparadies Hawaii ist die drei Hektar große Kaffeefarm von Erika Empey in Gefahr. Wildschweine wüten auf dem Gelände nahe der Ortschaft Kailua-Kona, und auch invasiver Bambus stellt eine Bedrohung für die Kulturpflanzen der Plantage dar.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Die beiden Aussteiger TL und Donna Johnson wohnen mitten in der ausgedörrten Halbwüste in Arizona. Doch ohne sauberes Wasser, ohne eigene Nahrungsquelle und umzingelt von hungrigen Wölfen steht ihr Traum vom Selbstversorgerdasein vor dem Aus. Die Outdoorexperten Marty, Matt und Misty Raney besuchen das verzweifelte Paar auf seinem entlegenen Grundstück, um zu retten, was zu retten ist. Ein Trinkwasser-Filtersystem und ein Truthahngehege sollen den Buschlandbewohnern eine zweite Chance geben.

In Brunswick möbeln Chase Morrill und sein Team ein Wahrzeichen mit Geschichte auf. Alte Schwarz-Weiß-Fotos belegen, dass am Bunganuc Creek einst Schiffe gebaut wurden. In der heruntergekommenen Hütte muss erstmal haufenweise Müll entsorgt werden.
Luke Houghton und seine Frau Laura besitzen am Damariscotta Lake ein Blockhaus. Darin möchten sie im Sommer Zeit mit ihren Kindern verbringen.

pr.t: Weird or What? With William Shatner
pr.d: A painting is reportedly linked to a series of house fires in Britain; a malevolent doll ruins lives; a California heiress begins a bizarre construction project.
A look at the eerie sightings of flying saucers that airline pilots have reported.
Examine instances where fighter pilots have been sent to intercept enemy aircraft - only to encounter unearthly flying machines.

In 1952, radar picked up a series of UFOs flying over Washington DC. The story hits the newspapers, overshadowing the presidential campaign, so President Truman fights the UFOs with his most powerful weapons: disinformation and bureaucracy.
UFO researchers believe NASA is hiding the truth about alien life. Could the deathbed confessions of famous scientists reveal a history of otherworldly contact?
From the lore and history of Ancient Egypt, to the myths of Native Americans, and even the art of the Renaissance period, mankind's past is riddled with the evidence of UFOs.
A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.
Cousins Billy and John Smith encounter a massive ship triple the size of a football stadium, and guards at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana spot an unidentified object overhead.
A woman claims breast implants saved her life and a young man saves a woman.
A hitchhiker spots a pattern of lights and is terrified when they seem to attack him. A sighting in France becomes one of the most investigated cases in UFO history.
Strange light patterns are seen across multiple counties in Texas. In France, after an intense encounter, a man's previous knee injury is completely healed.
In Nova Scotia, a former naval officer sees five bright lights in the skies. He is able to see a cigar-shaped object behind the light, about 20 feet in length.
Cousins Billy and John Smith encounter a massive ship triple the size of a football stadium, and guards at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana spot an unidentified object overhead.
In 1980, a UFO detected on military radar, landed near crucial NATO bases. A group of military personnel claim to have seen a shiny metallic object with coloured lights and hieroglyphic inscriptions.
In the 80s and 90s, sightings of dark, triangular flying objects began to occur across the world - many incidents remaining unexplained.
'Roswell' is perhaps the most famous UFO incident of all time. This controversial event is probed here.
A man changes personalities after a heart transplant and perfect circles of ice are formed. A mother is unrelated to her biological children.
The US military is investigating whether conflicts could be fought through mind control and a boy who lost his thumb in a horrific accident uses a mysterious powder to regrow it.
An abandoned city in remote jungles could be the home of an ancient treasure. Also, could a mysterious stone circle be the fabled round table of King Arthur?
When experts investigate a network of tunnels rumoured to be the hiding place of lost royal treasure, they find evidence of human sacrifice for a Viking god.
In Michigan, a father and son see strange lights and call the sheriff's office. In France, a craft known as Angel Hair is spotted hovering over school grounds.
On Halloween night in 2004 the police receive over 50 UFO reports in the Chicago area. And in Buck's County, a contractor sees a large object pass over his home.
US Air Force reservists are pursued by lights while flying back to their base. Plus, constable Godfrey loses consciousness when he investigates a strange disruption.
A hitchhiker spots a pattern of lights and is terrified when they seem to attack him. A sighting in France becomes one of the most investigated cases in UFO history.
Some places in the world record more UAP sightings than the rest, attracting people hoping to glimpse a flying saucer.
A look at UAPs seen diving into oceans at high speeds and the possibility that they seek refuge in Earth's depths.

In 1964, while Charles James Hall was stationed at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, he encountered an alien race he refers to as the "Tall Whites". He claims they were working with the US military and housed a spaceship in a secret hangar nearby.
During the Cold War, sinister objects were seen flying above secret military bases. Were aliens monitoring the world's nuclear arsenal?
On February 25, 1942, the skies over the sprawling city of Los Angeles erupt like a volcano. Anti-aircraft weapons fire wildly at strange targets.

A strange lake in Transylvania is the home of an abandoned village and a terrifying secret. When a labyrinth is discovered on an island once home to an ancient Greek civilization, experts investigate if it was the legendary home of the Minotaur.
Could a 1945 reconnaissance photo reveal the hometown of Biblical giant Goliath? Also, strange, otherworldly formations lie on the seabed near the Bahamas.

John Lennon and May Pang claimed to have seen a UFO from their balcony in New York, and a sinister visitor to a remote nuclear missile launch site in Montana, which more than 40 years ago caused nuclear missiles to be disabled for 24 hours.
A UFO is recorded flying straight from the sky into the sea with no loss of speed. Plus, astronaut Neil Armstrong goes in search of an ancient extraterrestrial library in the Ecuadorian jungle.
Throughout history, unexplained illnesses have repeatedly attacked the human population with a vengeance.
Some places in the world record more UAP sightings than the rest, attracting people hoping to glimpse a flying saucer.
A look at UAPs seen diving into oceans at high speeds and the possibility that they seek refuge in Earth's depths.
A battle worthy of Hollywood that established the glory of Ramses II when he faced the king Muwatalli II at Qadesh.
An exploration of Queensland's tropical coast with UFO stories of first-hand witnesses, from flying saucers to strange encounters in sugar cane fields.
The infamous Borgia family were devastated when favourite son Juan was murdered in 1497. Can modern experts crack the case and finger the killer?

Bradley explores the Great Sphinx and the underground Serapeum with its precision-cut granite sarcophagi, questioning their purpose and links to the pyramid enigma. Travelling south, he visits the intricately designed Dendera Temple.
El Yunque National Park harbours a powerful creature called the Chupacabra that is linked to UFO sightings in the area, leading to theories of a US government facility conducting secret experiments.

Visitors to Pennsylvania's Gettysburg National Park report numerous sightings of ghosts, which appear to be soldiers from one of the bloodiest battles in US history. Long before the Civil War researchers discover the area's bloody history from Native American battles. This leads to speculation that there is something about Gettysburg that has created a hotbed for ghostly activity.
A look at how the new Cold War involving the US, Russia, the UK and China could play out. Will trade and cyber warfare be the worst of it, or is military war inevitable?
Explore the huge Nazca lines that were made over 2,000 years ago and are still a mystery to researchers today.
The biggest mysteries that surround some of the biggest families in America, including the disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa.
Exploring the idea that aliens may have had a hand in humans' technological advancements.
The Fermi Paradox highlights the high likelihood of advanced life in the universe.
